posts.title: Photography News: Panasonic SHX1 Announced, Fuji X Summit on Dec. 2
posts.description: “Libor, are we going to need a tripod today?” This is probably the question I hear most often during my workshops. And my answer has remained consistent over the years: “Of course! It’s always a good idea to have a tripod with you.” This week, on the ridges of Slovakia’s Veľká Fatra mountains, I was reminded why making exceptions to tried-and-tested rules doesn’t always pay off. As we headed into an impenetrable fog in the fading light, I was convinced that carrying a tripod in my backpack would be nothing but unnecessary extra weight. To be honest, I felt much the same about my camera, but I took it along out of habit anyway.
